# Ananta Tours & Travels

> Koraput sightseeing journeys for families and groups in a new 17-seater AC Traveller with a local driver, support staff and guided-tour assistance. Based in Semiliguda, Koraput district, Odisha, India. Enquiries on WhatsApp +91 79787 07236; no payment is requested before an itinerary, price and availability are confirmed.

Key facts:
- Vehicle: one brand-new Force Traveller, 17 passenger seats, air conditioned, all-India permit, registration OD02 DT 9296, delivered 4 September 2026.
- Team: local driver, support staff on WhatsApp, guided-tour assistance.
- Pickups: Koraput Junction (KRPU), Damanjodi, Jeypore, Araku, Rayagada, Vizianagaram and Visakhapatnam stations; Jeypore Airport (IndiaOne Air); Koraput bus stand.
- Pricing: per trip, quoted in writing on WhatsApp for the agreed route and days.
- Contact: WhatsApp +91 79787 07236, phone +91 76098 35466 / +91 82609 03443, email saramanihembram434@gmail.com, Kalinga Nagar, Semiliguda, Koraput 764036, Odisha.
- Languages: English (https://itswadesh.github.io/ananta-tours-website/), ଓଡ଼ିଆ (https://itswadesh.github.io/ananta-tours-website/or/), हिन्दी (https://itswadesh.github.io/ananta-tours-website/hi/), বাংলা (https://itswadesh.github.io/ananta-tours-website/bn/), తెలుగు (https://itswadesh.github.io/ananta-tours-website/te/).

## Destinations (drive time from Koraput town)
- Deomali (Mountain): Odisha's highest peak at 1,672 m. Open grassland on top, valleys on every side, and a road that climbs almost to the summit. About 2 h, about 70 km.
- Rani Duduma (Waterfall): A quieter waterfall near Nandapur, reached by a country road through paddy fields and forest. About 1.5 h, about 50 km.
- Duduma Waterfall (Waterfall): The Machkund river drops about 175 m into a forested gorge on the Odisha–Andhra border. About 3 h, about 90 km.
- Gupteswar Cave Temple (Cave and pilgrimage): A limestone cave shrine above the Sabari river. About 200 steps climb through forest to the Shiva lingam. About 2.5 h, about 80 km.
- Upper Kolab Reservoir (Reservoir and garden): A dam, a terraced garden and a wide reservoir at about 3,000 ft. The easy evening stop on the way back. About 35 min, about 20 km.
- Sabara Srikhetra (Temple): Koraput's Jagannath temple, open to everyone and rooted in the region's tribal traditions. In town, about 2 km.
- Tribal Museum (Museum): Homes, textiles, tools and wall art of Koraput's Adivasi communities. Worth an hour before you drive through their landscape. In town, about 2 km.
- Maliguda (Railway and valley): The Kirandul railway crosses the Eastern Ghats here on bridges and tunnels. The Maliguda tunnel alone runs about 4 km. About 50 min, about 27 km.
- Nandapur (Heritage): The old capital before Jeypore, with the 32-step Batrisa Singhasana throne and small stone shrines. About 1.25 h, about 45 km.
- Onukadelli (Weekly market): A Thursday market near Duduma where Bonda and other communities trade. We visit quietly and photograph only with consent. About 3 h, about 90 km.
- Talamali (Offbeat hilltop): A flat-topped hill above Pendajam, grass instead of forest, usually paired with the village of Putsil. We check the last stretch of road the week you travel. About 1.5 h, about 45 km.
- Kalyamali (Offbeat hilltop): Spelled Kaliamali as often as not. An open, grass-topped hill with long views towards Pottangi, and an honest walk at the end of the drive. About 1.75 h, about 55 km.
